provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: slice-and-lift: the single rank-4 decomposition of |N>^3 up to symmetry does not extend to |N>^4

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop at low priority; the first enumeration ran 6.4 hours on one core

notes: chi(N^3) = 4 exactly (Lean witness and rank-3 exclusion). A rank-4 decomposition of |N>^4 sliced along one qutrit gives a rank-4 decomposition of |N>^3 whose terms are related slice to slice by a Pauli and cube roots of unity. |N>^3 has one rank-4 decomposition up to its unitary symmetries, the Lean witness of M3StabRank, and no Pauli assignment satisfies the other two slices: every one misses by at least 1e-4. Supersedes the rank-3 exclusion at m=4 (chi >= 4, 63 CPU-minutes), which never fit the certificate budget. Puts the cell at 5 <= chi <= 7.
